description: we-compare compare entries ("spec-name file") that expect "differs" without naming expectPaths: any difference passes them, also a World Editor step that never applied. "entries": on a JSON kind (written before parseSpec refused that, 2026-11-17): give an entry its expectPaths from a real World Editor run, then take it out. "textEntries": on text, text-set, text-exact, bytes or wpm, which can't name paths (refused since 2026-11-17): compare the file as a JSON kind with expectPaths, or narrow it with lines to what must match, then take it out. Both only shrink (we-compare-runner.test.mjs fails on an entry that is no longer needed, and on a longer list). The entries left (2026-11-17, two World Editor runs each): boundary-flags-wpm (its Blight brush turns a random set of corners to the second ground tile), drag-stroke-quick and drag-stroke-raise (the editor's own ticks decide where a drag stamps), low-ground-d-open, water-floor-e-deep-3 and water-floor-e-shallow-3 (every corner of the map differs: 3200 to 4224 paths); each difference is an open point (bugs.md; the quick drag's gaps in onhold.md).
